page.overview:
Who is Big Ben?

In the Marvel Comics G.I. Joe series, he assists the Joes in defending Destro, when the allied group is entrenched in Destro's Trans-Carpathian castle.[37] He also appears in issue #137

In the Devil's Due G.I. Joe series, he assists the Joes when they invade Cobra Island to interfere in their second civil war.

Big Ben appeared in the animated series during the DiC Series (1989-1991) and often teamed up with 2 members of the October Guard: Red Star (Cpt. Krimov) and Big Bear. Big Ben in the DiC G.I. Joe cartoon, voiced by Maurice LaMarche

Episode 15, "General Confusion", finds the Joes in South America, investigating Cobra's interest in a grove of volatile "demon trees" and their equally explosive sap. Along for the exercise is Dr. Deborah Carday, in fact a disguised Zarana, posing as a US Senate oversight inspector. Dr. Carday picks the mission apart, with a running tally of each wasteful action, only pausing to flirt with a receptive Big Ben.
